title: Inside the Mindsets
coreMove: Success, failure, and effort drive behavior by meaning; change the meaning from judgment to learning, and the next choice changes too.

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: anchor the choice in the University of Hong Kong English course and the shame of accepting help

exampleSpecs.stakes: future study habits depend on what feedback is used for
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the brain-wave feedback study to contrast judgment attention with learning attention

exampleSpecs.stakes: comfort could keep the player below varsity pace
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use Mia Hamm to show seeking stronger players as growth behavior

exampleSpecs.stakes: discouragement could stop daily recovery work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: anchor the scene in Christopher Reeve and effort organized around recovery

exampleSpecs.audience: talented students ashamed of needing drills
exampleSpecs.stakes: protecting the prodigy image could stall development
